note: Curated candidates for the Expert (GitHub) edition only. Downloading and installing these is not available in the Play build: fetching executable code from a non-Play source is prohibited by the Device and Network Abuse policy (docs/distribution.md 2.1, D1). The Play build may list them for reference, and first-party plugins may be bundled in the APK instead.

status_meaning.supported: install, import, execute and round-trip all passed on a real run
status_meaning.needs-config: works, but the plugin directive must carry a configuration string
status_meaning.partial: some steps passed; the failing step is recorded in `tested.reason`
status_meaning.unsupported: a step failed; the reason is recorded
status_meaning.unavailable: could not be fetched or contains no loadable plugin; nothing was run
status_meaning.untested: listed only; no compatibility claim is made
